name: Camp Mechuwana
description_short: A Christian camp affiliated with the New England Conference of the United Methodist Church, on more than 200 acres of forest on Lower Narrows Pond and Lake Annabessacook. It runs weekly summer programs from mid-June to mid-August, including sports, swimming, musical theatre, creative arts, special needs camps and day camps.
special_needs_notes: Special needs camps are listed among the weekly summer offerings. Details are not given on this page.
swim_waterfront_notes: Property borders Lower Narrows Pond and Lake Annabessacook and has a boat dock and a swimming area.
